## Context / Problem
25 of the 221 bug tickets filed 7–21 Aug 2026 (11%) were duplicates or were refuted during debugging because the agent diagnosed against a stale local tree or a ticket that already existed. `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md` mandates a fresh worktree from `origin/main` (lines 40-43) and a sibling sweep (Step 7, lines 741-785) but has no step before Phase 1 that searches the tracker or compares the version the bug was reported against with `main`. The search-before-file rule lives only in `AGENTS.md`. Approved (2026-08-21) with the addition that the agent must compare the reported-against version to `main` as part of the investigation.

## Approach
Add "Step 0 — Orient" to the skill, before Phase 1: (a) `rebar search "<symptom words>"` and
`rebar list --status open --type bug`; an existing ticket is linked or resumed instead of filed;
(b) establish the **reported-against floor** (see below) and run
`git log --oneline <floor-sha>..origin/main -- <suspect paths>` so the hypothesis phase knows
whether the construct changed since the report; (c) confirm the worktree is at `origin/main`
(`git rev-parse HEAD` equals `origin/main`). Each step writes one line into the dossier.
Task `exemplary-hexahedral-needlefish` (tracker-side duplicate detection) is the complementary work.

### The reported-against floor — two real sources, in order
A rebar ticket has **no `rebar-version` field**; the earlier draft of this plan asserted one and
was wrong (verified: no such key in the ticket schema or `_store`). The floor is established
from, in order of preference:
1. **The report text** — a `rebar --version` output, a commit sha, or a release tag quoted in the
   bug's description or comments. This is authoritative when present.
2. **The ticket's `created_at`** — when the report quotes no version, take the newest `main`
   commit at or before the report:
   `git rev-list -1 --before="<created_at>" origin/main`. This is a FLOOR, not the exact build,
   so the dossier line records it as such ("reported on or after <sha>") and the agent does not
   claim more precision than it has.

If neither is available (no version quoted and no usable timestamp), Step 0 records
"reported-against version unknown" explicitly and the hypothesis phase treats the whole history
as in scope, rather than silently assuming `main`.

## Scope
`examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md`, `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/phases/` (if the dossier template lives there), `docs/user-guide.md` (one sentence), `tests/unit/test_skill_frontmatter.py` (existing skill lint passes).

## Testing
Documentation change; `scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` and the docs gates pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] SKILL.md contains a Step 0 preceding Phase 1 with the three actions and the dossier lines; checked by reading the file and by `grep -n "Step 0" examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md`.
- [ ] Step 0 names the two REAL floor sources (report text, then `created_at` via `git rev-list -1 --before=`) and nowhere references a ticket `rebar-version` field; checked by `grep -c "rebar-version" examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md` equal to 0.
- [ ] The unknown-version case is handled explicitly rather than defaulting to `main`; checked by reading the Step 0 text.
- [ ] The hypothesis template cites the reported-against floor and the diff range to `main`; checked by the dossier template text.
- [ ] `make lint` and the docs gates pass; checked by CI.

## Review remediation (2026-08-21)
Two blocking findings, both on the same defect: Approach (b) instructed the agent to read the
reported-against version from "the tracker ticket's `rebar-version` field". No such field exists
on a rebar ticket. A step that reads a non-existent field either crashes or silently yields
nothing, and the whole point of Step 0 is to stop diagnosing against the wrong tree — so the
mechanism is now stated in terms of sources that actually exist, with an explicit unknown case.
